DADC_JLR shall publish DILCStatus_Logging with the following encoding:


	UNDEFINED
	OFF
	ENABLED
	ACTIVE_CONTROL
	FAULT
By default, DADC_JLR shall set DILCStatus_Logging to "UNDEFINED"

WHILE

DILCStatus is "Off" OR "NotFitted" OR "Disabled" OR "Unpermitted" OR "Inoperable"


THEN

DADC_JLR shall set DILCStatus_Logging to "OFF"

WHILE

DILCStatus is "Standby" OR "Available_Idle"


THEN

DADC_JLR shall set DILCStatus_Logging to "ENABLED"

WHILE

DILCStatus is "Speed_Adapting_Left" OR "Speed_Adapting_Right" OR "Active_Left" OR "Active_Right" OR "Aborting_Left" OR "Aborting_Right"


THEN

DADC_JLR shall set DILCStatus_Logging to "ACTIVE_CONTROL"

WHILE

DILCStatus is "Fault"

DADC_JLR shall set DILCStatus_Logging to "Fault"

DirectionIndicatorLampStatus !== "Hazard"
THEN
DADC_JLR shall set the SetDILCROVPrecondtions to "Satisfied"

WHILE DILCSetting == "Off"
THEN

WHILE DILCFitmentStatus == false
THEN
DADC_JLR shall set the SetDILCROVPrecondtions to "Blocked"

WHILE TrailerStatus == "Connected"
THEN
DADC_JLR shall set the SetDILCROVPrecondtions to "Blocked"

WHILE HandsOffStage == "Stage 1" OR "Stage 2" OR "Stage 3"
THEN
DADC_JLR shall set the SetDILCROVPrecondtions to "Blocked"

WHILE DirectionIndicatorLampStatus == "Hazard"
THEN
DADC_JLR shall set the SetDILCROVPrecondtions to "Blocked"

WHILE DILCStatus == "Off" OR "NotFitted" OR "Disabled" OR "Standby" OR "Active_Left" Or "Active_Right" Or "Speed_Adapting_Left" Or "Speed_Adapting_Right" OR "Aborting_Left" OR "Aborting_Right" OR "Unpermitted" OR "Fault" "Inoperable"
THEN
DADC_JLR shall set RequestToIntitiateLaneChange to "NoRequest"

WHILE DILCStatus is "Available_Idle"
AND the time since the RequestToIntitiateLaneChange is greater than [Target 1 = 1s]
WHEN the DirectionIndicatorStalkPostition changes to "Latched_Right"
THEN within [Target_Network_delay] the DirectionIndicatorLampStatus is "Right"
the DADC_JLR shall send the RequestToIntitiateLaneChange "toRight"

WHILE DILCStatus is "Available_Idle"
AND the time since the RequestToIntitiateLaneChange is greater than [Target 1 = 1s]
WHEN the DirectionIndicatorStalkPostition changes to "Latched_Left"
THEN within [Target_Network_delay] the DirectionIndicatorLampStatus "Left"
the DADC_JLR shall set RequestToIntitiateLaneChange "toLeft"

WHILE DILCStatus is "Available_Idle"
AND the time since the RequestToIntitiateLaneChange is greater than [Target 1 = 1s]
WHEN the DirectionIndicatorStalkPostition changes to "Tipped_Right"
THEN within [CAL_Double_tip_threshold] the DirectionIndicatorStalkPostition changes from "None" to "Tipped_Right"
 THEN within [Target_Network_delay] the DirectionIndicatorLampStatus is "Right"
the DADC_JLR shall set the RequestToIntitiateLaneChange "toRight"

WHILE DILCStatus is "Available_Idle"
AND the time since the previous RequestToIntitiateLaneChange is greater than [Target 1 = 1s]
WHEN the DirectionIndicatorStalkPostition changes to"Tipped_Left"
THEN within [CAL_Double_tip_threshold] the DirectionIndicatorStalkPostition  changes from "None" to "Tipped_Left"
 THEN within [Target_Network_delay] the DirectionIndicatorLampStatus is "Left"
the DADC_JLR shall set the RequestToIntitiateLaneChange to "toLeft"

WHILE RequestToIntitiateLaneChange is "toLeft" OR "toRight"
WHEN VerifyInitiateLaneChange is "Success"
the DADC_JLR shall set the RequestToIntitiateLaneChange to "NoRequest"
